description: This file defines the XmlDocumentationProvider class, which implements interfaces for providing XML-based documentation for API controllers, actions, parameters, and members within a .NET web application.

classes.name: XmlDocumentationProvider
classes.description: A class that reads API documentation from an XML file and provides documentation strings for controllers, actions, parameters, and members.

methods.name: XmlDocumentationProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with the path to the XML documentation file.

methods.name: GetDocumentation
methods.description: Overloaded methods to retrieve documentation for controllers, actions, parameters, and members.

methods.name: GetResponseDocumentation
methods.description: Retrieves the 'returns' documentation for an API action.

methods.name: GetMethodNode
methods.description: Retrieves the XML node for a specific API action.

methods.name: GetMemberName
methods.description: Constructs the member name string used in XML documentation for methods.

methods.name: GetTagValue
methods.description: Extracts the value of a specific XML tag from a parent node.

methods.name: GetTypeNode
methods.description: Retrieves the XML node for a specific type.

methods.name: GetTypeName
methods.description: Generates the string representation of a type, handling generics and nested types.
